Israel Culture Club

Syracuse University & SUNY ESF

A student‑led home to learn about, enjoy, and experience Israeli and Jewish culture.

250+ members, the largest student‑run Jewish organization at Syracuse.

See what we run Join the club
Mission

We're a community for students who feel represented by — or just want to enjoy — Israeli culture: song, dance, food, language, conversation.

A place to be Jewish, or curious about Jews.

The other half is education, running both ways. Outward, to students never offered an accurate picture of Israeli and Jewish life. Inward, to Jewish students still finding footing in their own identity.

When antisemitism surfaces on campus, we respond quickly and confront it wherever we can.

Size
250+ members — the largest student‑run Jewish org at Syracuse.
For
Jews, non‑Jews, and anyone else interested in Israeli culture.
Status
Registered student organization. Student‑led, no full‑time staff.
To join
Any SU or SUNY ESF student. No qualifications, no requirements.
